scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix vite install && npm --prefix firebase install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix vite run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix vite run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix vite run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix vite run test && npm run test:dev-startup && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:coord
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run test:watch" "npm --prefix vite run test:watch"
scripts.verify: npm run db:check && npm run schema:dump -- --check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:integration
